parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Use a logarithm law for a product, quotient, or power [M1]; condone $\ln\dfrac{x}{x-1}$ for M1. Obtain a correct equation free of logarithms, e.g. $(2x-3)(x-1)=x^2$ or $x^2-5x+3=0$ [A1]. Solve a 3-term quadratic and obtain at least one root [M1; working required if the quadratic is incorrect]. Obtain $x=4.30$ only [A1; 2 d.p.; do not ISW; overspecification loses A1]. Total 4.
